traceability.notes: The require-branch-annotation ESLint rule and its supporting utilities implement the branch-level traceability requirements from docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md. The rule enforces @story and @req annotations on all configured branch types (if, switch cases, try/catch, and loops), supports a configurable branchTypes option with robust validation, associates comments to branches (including special handling for SwitchCase), parses annotations from comments, and provides clear, consistent error messages and auto-fix suggestions. It is integrated into the plugin’s recommended/strict flat config presets. Dedicated unit and rule tests reference this story and validate both normal and edge-case behavior, and all tests pass. User-facing documentation for the rule exists and matches the implemented behavior. On this basis, the story is fully implemented.
